definition: A fictional insurer used by The Open Group and the Archi tool to illustrate ArchiMate. This atlas is built from the Archi sample model.
ArchiSurance's shared service centre that turns paper claim forms and contracts into electronic documents.
The business interface intermediaries use to reach ArchiSurance in the Archi model, shown here as the Intermediary Portal.
The payment network in the Archi model that connects ArchiSurance's Bank System with customers' banks.
